meta/muse-spark-1.2-contributor.reason: Contributor is Meta's data-terms tier of Muse Spark 1.2: same weights and capabilities, discounted to 0.1/0.2 because prompts and outputs may be used to improve Meta's models; still meta/muse-spark-1.2.

meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.reason: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor serves the same Muse Spark 1.3 weights at a discounted 0.1/0.2 rate in exchange for training-data rights (it only omits the maximum reasoning effort level); still meta/muse-spark-1.3.

stealth/glyph-cluster:free.reason: Stealth preview reasoning model from an anonymous third-party provider; identity unknown and no catalog entry, so re-check once the provider or models.dev reveals the model.

xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed.reason: UltraSpeed is Xiaomi's fast serving built from the same 1T MiMo-V2.6-Pro checkpoint; a speed-tier serving is still that model, priced at a ~10x speed premium.
